summary_en: Annual dividend per share raised to ¥255 (pre-3-for-1 split basis), from ¥220. Q2 payout increased from ¥110 to ¥120; year-end payout adjusted to ¥45 (¥135 pre-split equivalent) to reflect 3-for-1 stock split effective October 1, 2026. Payout ratio 75.0%. Based on revised FY3/27 earnings guidance (net profit +12.3% YoY).
title_en: Notice on Revision of Consolidated Financial Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Upward Revision) and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Hakuto revised its FY3/27 (year ending March 31, 2027) dividend forecast upward on July 29, 2026. Annual dividend per share on a pre-split basis is now projected at ¥255, up from the prior forecast of ¥220. The second-quarter dividend was raised from ¥110 to ¥120 per share; the year-end dividend was adjusted to ¥45 per share (equivalent to ¥135 on a pre-split basis) to account for a 3-for-1 stock split effective October 1, 2026. The revised payout ratio is 75.0%. The increase reflects upward revision of FY3/27 consolidated net profit (+12.3% versus prior forecast to ¥6.4 billion), driven by strong demand in AI and data-center markets for semiconductors, optical components, and connectors, plus favorable currency effects. Management stated the hike aligns with its medium-term plan "Hakuto 2028" targets of stable dividend growth, a payout ratio of 70% (±5%), and a dividend yield floor (DOE) of 5%.
